第72章 想进来可以，按我的规矩来-《重生2000：撕了协议我暴富了》

下午两点，张江科技园区。

领头的是个四十出头的男人，灰色西装，金边眼镜，头发纹丝不乱。

身后跟着三个人，两男一女，都拎着公文包，步子整齐。

叶知秋迎上去，伸出手。

“您好，九州创投特别助理叶知秋。齐总说过您——陈总监，欢迎来张江。”

陈启明握了一下，轻触即分。

“齐总交代得很清楚，我们先看项目，数据核实完了，他本人明早落地。”

叶知秋没多寒暄，直接带人上楼。

第一站，芯海微电子二期实验室。

门禁刷开的那一刻，陈启明的步子慢了半拍。

三千五百平的无尘车间，通信基带芯片的晶圆测试线已经跑起来了。

从一号楼走到三号楼，陈启明前前后后花了四十分钟。

每栋楼进去都转一圈，问了几个入驻企业的负责人几个专业问题，

从三号楼的电梯下来，陈启明站在大厅里，背着手，没说话。

他身后的年轻人正在整理拍的照片和记录的数据。

叶知秋站在旁边等着。

陈启明掏出手机，点开齐衡的对话框，打了一行字发了出去：

“数据真实，项目扎实，比预期的好。建议尽快推进。”

傍晚六点一刻。

震旦大厦楼下。

顾城靠在他那辆兰博基尼的车门上，叼着根没点的烟。

看见林川从旋转门里出来，他把烟从嘴里拿下来，在裤腿上弹了两下。

“来了。”

“等多久了？”

“十分钟。”顾城拉开车门坐进去。

“今晚到场的，除了中投信达和华清的两个主要负责人，各带了一个助理。然后就是周处，还有一个张江子项目的负责人老吴。”

林川绕到副驾坐进去，系上安全带。

”顾城发动引擎。

“川子，今晚怎么整？”

“到了再说。”

顾城瞥了他一眼，没追问。

兰博基尼汇入南京西路的车流，二十分钟后停在外滩十八号门口。

一个穿西装的酒店工作人员已经等在台阶下面了。

“林总、顾总，周处长在三楼等您二位。”

上了电梯，走过一段铺着厚地毯的走廊。

工作人员推开包间的门。

里面已经坐了五个人。

周处长坐在主位正对面，看见林川进来，立刻站起来。

“林总来了！快请坐快请坐！”

然后给林川介绍在座的几人。

热情得过分。

林川扫了一圈。

周处长右手边坐着一个五十来岁的男人，方脸，深色西装，

胸前别着一枚金色的司徽——中投信达的标志。

左手边是个四十出头的人，偏瘦，戴无框眼镜，坐得笔直，面前的茶杯摆得极正。

华清资本的孙姓合伙人孙乾。

再往旁边，是园区老吴和中投信达的助理。

林川笑了一下，主动伸手。

“方总，孙总，久仰。”

方副总裁站起来，握手。

Two o'clock in the afternoon, Zhangjiang Science and Technology Park.

The leader is a man in his early forties, wearing a gray suit, gold-rimmed glasses, and his hair is not messed up.

Behind him were three people, two men and one woman, all carrying briefcases and walking in neat steps.

Ye Zhiqiu went up to meet him and stretched out his hand.

"Hello, Ye Zhiqiu, special assistant of Jiuzhou Venture Capital. Mr. Qi said that you, Director Chen, welcome to Zhangjiang."

Chen Qiming held it and divided it with a light touch.

"Mr. Qi made it very clear that we will look at the project first, and after the data verification is completed, he will implement it tomorrow morning."

Ye Zhiqiu didn't say much and took people upstairs directly.

The first stop is Chipsea Microelectronics Phase II Laboratory.

The moment the access control opened, Chen Qiming's steps slowed down for half a beat.

In the 3,500-square-meter dust-free workshop, the wafer test line for communication baseband chips is already in operation.

It took Chen Qiming forty minutes to walk from Building 1 to Building 3.

After entering each building, I walked around and asked a few professional questions to the heads of several resident companies.

After getting off the elevator in Building 3, Chen Qiming stood in the lobby with his hands behind his back and said nothing.

The young man behind him is sorting out the photos and recorded data.

Ye Zhiqiu stood aside and waited.

Chen Qiming took out his mobile phone, opened Qi Heng's dialog box, typed a line of text and sent it:

"The data is real and the project is solid, better than expected. It is recommended to proceed as soon as possible."

A quarter past six in the evening.

Downstairs of Aurora Building.

Gu Cheng leaned against the door of his Lamborghini, holding an unlit cigarette.

Seeing Lin Chuan come out of the revolving door, he took the cigarette out of his mouth and flicked it on his trouser legs twice.

"Coming."

"How long have you been waiting?"

"Ten minutes." Gu Cheng opened the car door and got in.

"Those present tonight, in addition to the two main persons in charge of CIC Xinda and Huaqing, each brought an assistant. Then there is Zhou Chu, and there is also Lao Wu, the person in charge of the Zhangjiang sub-project."

Lin Chuan walked around to the passenger seat, got in, and put on his seat belt.

"Gu Cheng started the engine.

"Kawako, what are you going to do tonight?"

“Let’s talk about it when we get there."

Gu Cheng glanced at him and didn't ask any further questions.

The Lamborghini merged into the traffic on Nanjing West Road and stopped at the gate of No. 18 on the Bund twenty minutes later.

A hotel staff member in a suit was already waiting at the foot of the steps.

"Mr. Lin, Mr. Gu, and Director Zhou are waiting for you two on the third floor."

Got on the elevator and walked through a corridor covered with thick carpets.

The staff pushed open the private room door.

Five people were already sitting inside.

Director Zhou was sitting directly opposite the main seat. When he saw Lin Chuan coming in, he immediately stood up.

"Mr. Lin is here!Please take a seat. Please take a seat!"

Then he introduced Lin Chuan to the people present.

Enthusiastic to a fault.

Lin Chuan scanned around.

Sitting on Director Zhou's right is a man in his fifties, with a square face and a dark suit.

There is a golden company emblem on his chest - the logo of CIC Xinda.

On the left is a man in his early forties, thin, wearing rimless glasses, sitting upright, with the teacup in front of him placed very upright.

Sun Qian, a partner surnamed Sun of Huaqing Capital.

Further to the side are Lao Wu from the park and an assistant from Cinda.

Lin Chuan smiled and reached out his hand.

"Mr. Fang, Mr. Sun, I have admired you for a long time."

Vice President Fang stood up and shook hands.
